summary: FEAT-004 meets its spec: check_mixed_run gains --expect-synth-prob (window_steps-weighted synth_frac, 4-sigma bound, exact at p 0/1, BN-recal floor(planned*p) matching run.py's event keys) and --min-task-steps (trace count 1 and summed window_steps, NIT 1 4x25 test), both off by default; r_level{4,2,1}.sh carry identical validated SYNTH_*/GPU_POLL/MIN_TASK_STEPS blocks with the synth flags only for SYNTH_PROB > 0 and before EXTRA_ARGS, a poll started after mkdir and stopped after main.py plus an EXIT trap, and paired smoke lines matching design 7.2; r_level1 has 128G and TF limit 42500 (OD3); default command lines byte-identical to HEAD except the OD3 limit (H4). DALI check s, verify_synth.sh, synth_preview.py/.sh follow cluster policy and the synth API. Tests were run and logged (94 OK bgr_preproc38, 46 OK tf_gpu, bash -n, dry runs, local PNG). Two NITs: nvidia-smi index vs CUDA order on unconstrained mixed nodes, and the preview has not yet run in the container on a CPU node.
